The part of NASA's Moon mission no crew has ever tried before
caption:
Artemis III is the most ambitious Moon mission since Apollo. Unlike anything before it, this crew has to dock their capsule with a commercial spacecraft near the Moon, then switch vehicles to actually land. No astronaut has ever done that handoff in lunar orbit.

SpaceX built the lander for this mission, meaning the whole thing depends on two completely separate spacecraft meeting up perfectly near the Moon. NASA calls it one of the most complex things they have ever attempted.
